description:
## Goal

Make backend executable and callable-construction references independent of root enumeration, so adding or removing an unrelated reachable member cannot change an existing member's identity or force a body copy. Migrate every backend consumer atomically and share immutable member payloads.

## Current evidence at 167faceaa

BackendProgram in src/compiler2/artifact.rs owns entry: usize, Vec<BackendExecutable> and Vec<BackendConstructionWrapper>. Backend bodies embed root-assigned executable usize targets and u32 construction identities. jobs/backend.rs produce_root_backend_product creates a semantic-sorted executable_index and construction enumeration; package_symbolic_backend_executable then clones metadata and traverses SymbolicBackendBody into BackendBody because these references depend on root membership. NativeLowerer and ir_interp/backend.rs consume these dense positions.

Thus an earlier-sorted reachable insertion can rewrite references in an otherwise unchanged body. Rc symbolic inputs do not avoid the second packaging traversal or final payload copies. A keyed contribution optimization cannot preserve immutable member identity on top of that model.

Struct membership is already derived from reached backends with exact StructDefined reads; do not recreate a whole-World schema bug or broaden this ticket into source ownership.

## Strategy

1. Reuse existing typed semantic executable and construction ownership identities wherever possible; introduce no rendered/canonical type authority, raw-mint ordering, duplicate identity registry, or root-relative index as semantic authority.
2. Make BackendExecutable(E) the complete immutable consumer-ready local artifact, with exact ABI/layout/return/construction dependencies. Collapse SymbolicBackend and Backend duplicate body forms/traversal at the cutover, not through a compatibility layer.
3. Make BackendProgram hold immutable shared keyed member payloads and typed entry/reference identities. Migrate interpreter, native lowering, dumps, canonical rendering, macro roots, and tests together.
4. Keep any required dense ordinals at actual native link/runtime representation or canonical display boundaries. Do not recover old root remapping through a second cache, adapter, fallback scanner, or parallel authority.
5. Preserve efficient interpreter/native calls. Investigate representation cost explicitly rather than replacing direct calls with unmeasured expensive lookup or copying.
6. Leave exact delta root membership/contribution reconciliation to fz-tfn.18, which remains blocked on this ticket. Do not claim the remaining whole-root inventory rebuild is incremental. Immutable membership collection updates must eventually use structural sharing, not Rc<HashMap>::make_mut copying retained snapshots; fz-tfn.18 owns that remaining proof.

## TDD signal and acceptance

- Minimal retained main -> left/right, right -> zleaf program: retain right's executable allocation and typed target; edit left to reach an earlier-sorted aleaf. Right keeps its exact allocation, generation where applicable, and target identity. Reverse the edit and withdraw aleaf without rewriting right.
- A relevant right/zleaf edit changes exactly the appropriate artifact/dependency, not a stale reused body.
- Callable construction references remain exact across insertion/removal and preserve direct-only, boxed, captured, zero-lane, recursive and polymorphic obligations.
- Backend member payloads share existing immutable allocations; no second body conversion or root-relative executable/construction remap survives.
- Preserve runtime output, diagnostics, ABI/calling contracts, effects, source metadata, and canonical artifact fidelity. Proven-unused removal is permitted with explicit causal proof under the epic's approved acceptance; same-version determinism/reuse remain mandatory.
- No new compiler cache/store beside World facts and retained ProductMemo. Necessary local ordinal projections are consumers, not alternate semantic authorities.
- Full library, serial fixture matrix, interp/run/build and native/macro tests, cross-process canonical/causal checks, formatting/check/strict clippy and relevant documentation pass.
- Fresh ticket-scoped cold review; one commit and close. Any newly discovered prerequisite must be evidenced and ticketed before work; no silent scope reduction.

## Concordance and remaining work

fz-tfn.18 owns exact executable/wrapper/atom/schema contribution updates, rooted recursive-cycle withdrawal and deletion of root inventory scans, union_boxed aggregation, repeated atom walks and schema copies. Its scope is unchanged.

fz-tfn.13 consumes these stable backend references when defining native-body/link identities; it still owns native per-body lowering/codegen products and deletion of the post-lowering sharing pass. This ticket does not implement a parallel native identity model or claim body-incremental codegen complete.

## Implementation evidence and dependency model

The retained RED backend_member_survives_reachable_sibling_insertion_and_withdrawal in compiler2_test.rs runs main -> left/right and right -> zleaf, then republishes left to reach a previously unrequested aleaf. An explicit prior function reference establishes aleaf earlier in the existing typed semantic order. At 167faceaa, program output remains 42 and right's BackendExecutable product generation stays equal, but right's direct target changes from root ordinal 4 to 5. The preceding variant also failed exact complete-backend allocation sharing. The initial RED was recorded before production edits.

Complete local backend production can read own AbiExecutable plus exact ABI owners named by CallReturnFlow source positions, construction member resolutions, and construction capture source positions. ABI products do not depend on BackendExecutable, avoiding backend recursion cycles. Return/resume endpoint contracts already live in ABI. Entry capture physical lanes are determined by the local position layout and local runtime demand using the existing block parameter representation selector; a root-wide seam scan is not required to determine them.

Consumer audit: interpreter frames repeatedly access dense member ordinals at entry/resume. Each runtime and macro invocation creates a fresh interpreter, so a fresh per-run prelink pass would repeat work on unchanged input. Keep semantic references stable and evaluate minimal typed-key resolution at actual call/construction boundaries; any necessary ordinal projection is strictly runtime/link representation, never embedded member identity. Native already predeclares local FnIds and can project existing stable keys at that boundary.

Pre-change artifact baseline: clean HEAD 167faceaaef507c2b63cd0495eb216855c41e796, binary SHA256 690d40193f41a8677aa26036f2843e98edc9fb6bd066dcdd53760255446a1717. Root captured /tmp/fz-tfn44-before.MpIvXv/{range,predicate,take-drop}.{backend,jsonl,clif,native,native.jsonl}; all three interpreter and native runs exited 0 with expected outputs. Preserve this provenance for exact after comparison.

## Cutover implementation and first GREEN

BackendExecutable is the single complete backend member: stable ExecutableKey, retained Rc<AbiReadyExecutable>, BackendBody with typed semantic targets, and local Rc construction wrappers. Metadata reads stay on their existing immutable ABI/materialized authority instead of cloned backend fields. SymbolicBackend body types and the second root packaging traversal are deleted. Construction identity is the exact positioned TransportPosition; CallableId alone is not site identity.

BackendProgram constructs semantic-ordered Vec<Rc<member>> runtime/link inventories and private key-to-ordinal projections together, rejecting duplicate semantic keys and absent entry membership. Entry and inventories are private with read-only accessors. Embedded backend targets never contain ordinals. Native projects its existing FnIds at link time; interpreter resolves the stable key at call/construction boundaries, keeps existing ordinal frame/resume access, and resolves runtime wrapper words directly by vector index instead of the old linear search. No fresh per-run link pass, parallel mutable registry, or linked-body copy exists.

First GREEN: cargo test --lib backend_member_survives_reachable_sibling_insertion_and_withdrawal passed after libtest compilation. Both insertion and reverse withdrawal retain right's exact Rc allocation, product generation and typed zleaf target, with output 42. Production cargo check --lib passed; subsequent dead production-only helper warnings were removed. Full gates, constructor rejection tests, relevant edit/construction identity proofs, before/after artifacts and final cold review remain pending. This is not a completion claim or changed acceptance.

## Verification milestone

The strengthened direct-member retained test passes after explicitly proving aleaf absent -> present -> absent and changed-left allocation movement. A relevant zleaf body edit changes output 42 -> 43 and its allocation while retaining the caller's equal ABI/body allocation. Replacing right changes output to 44, publishes a new right member and withdraws its former zleaf target while retaining left. The first-class construction test also passes: insertion/removal changes the wrapper inventory by exactly one and shifts right's runtime ordinal, but preserves its typed TransportPosition identity, exact wrapper/member Rc allocations and BackendExecutable generation. Added constructor rejection witnesses for duplicate executable key, duplicate construction position and missing entry; full serial library gate is running.

After artifact evidence (root-owned): /tmp/fz-tfn44-after.5VI4nf, fz2 SHA256 17962d84577f175fa296dfdac0f25f011ffd4b3233f27610c6fd1c832e22f88a; production core diff SHA256 c97085434bb1319f871427e86f503a61a7f0bdb6a83295c14ec3ecff3a387a7f. Range, predicate and take/drop interpreter/native runs all exit 0 with expected outputs. All three canonical BackendProgram dumps and all three CLIF dumps are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline. Raw native Debug output differs in incidental map/interner representation and is not claimed as the canonical comparator.

All-session settled counts remain equal for every product family; evaluated counts remain equal for every family except BackendExecutable. Backend produced/waiting outcomes reduce respectively: range 62/62 -> 62/47, predicate 168/168 -> 168/116, take/drop 239/239 -> 239/147. The new exact local ABI prerequisites expose dependent ABI demands before root traversal later asks for those complete backends; measured reduction is waiting retries, not omitted completed members. Repeat interpreter captures /tmp/fz-tfn44-repeat.FyOGgs reproduce canonical bytes and all evaluated/settled family counts. Full cross-process causal graph CLI gate remains required; these representative comparisons do not replace full gates or cold review.
title: Make backend members immutable and references independent of root enumeration
